Ravi: deploy-bot reports an embeddings regression in ap-south during the maintenance window. similarity p95 -6% at 20% canary. recommend rollback? :thinking:

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: Alert for release v2.4.2-quantx. embeddings_similarity -6.0%, latency_p95 +90ms, error_rate unchanged. Suggested action: ROLLBACK.

Kim: We have two enterprise tenants on that canary slice. No active SLA alerts yet.

Evan: Observability shows KV miss spike and slightly elevated CPU on host ap3. Looks like quant profile mismatch.

Ravi: Manual rollback preferred (change window auto-revert suppressed). Plan: pin to v2.4.1, drain canary, warm caches. Kim/Evan to execute; I'll draft cust note.

Kim: Executing now. Commands: ```redwoodctl routes set --region ap --pool dedicated --model v2.4.1 --pin; redwoodctl deploy scale --id deploy-ap-20250610-qx --target 0```

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: Manual rollback initiated by @Kim. Canary traffic set to 0%. Hooks posted to observability and incident tracker.

Evan: Drain complete. p95 similarity returning to baseline. Caches warmed.

SRE-Oncall: Created INC-20250610-emb for postmortem. Please attach quant config and short-query evals.

Ravi: Customer note drafted: "We observed a temporary embeddings quality regression during a canary rollout in ap-south. We've rolled back to the previous model and are monitoring. No customer data exposed. We'll follow up with next steps." Publishing after Kim + SRE ack.

Kim: Ack. Leaving pin for 90 minutes per policy. Reopen thread if metrics deviate. :lock:
